what: Take 1 passed vo_soundcheck (accuracy 0.991, 42.5 s, -19.5 LUFS) and the mix and alignment succeeded, but board_retime.py refused: 'measured narration-picture retiming failed: authored clause must equal complete measured cue text'.
cause: The authored narration_picture clauses n3a|n3b ('Clinicians sign in with their usual credentials' | 'and ask in plain language.') and n4a|n4b ('The answers carry citations' | 'to medical literature and clinical guidelines.') split sentences mid-flow. The measured words show no silence at those two joins: credentials ends 14.48 s and 'and' starts 14.48 s; citations ends 17.55 s and 'to' starts 17.55 s. Every other clause boundary has measured silence of 0.34 s or more. Measured captions therefore carry one cue per sentence for those two sentences.
correction: Direction-only (narration-performance): ask for a short natural breath after 'credentials' and after 'citations' so the two clause joins have measured silence. Script, board, claims, sources and renderer stay frozen.
